summary.text: Qi Engulfing Mountains and Rivers is Duke Long's qi path immortal killer move. Unparalleled pressure slams from all around, collapsing other killer moves and dropping everything that is not him.

claims.text: In Eastern Sea, after sending Feng Jin Huang away with Li Huang, Duke Long stops protecting her and turns his full power on the contest for Dragon Palace. He shuts his eyes, waits until surrounding killer moves reach him, then opens them and activates the move. Gu Immortals at rank eight shake as pressure slams from all around; their killer moves, the sky, and the sea all face it. Many killer moves collapse. The rank eight Gu Immortals and Dragon Palace fall into the water. The world becomes still. Only Duke Long remains standing in the sky, looking down with cold dragon pupils. A few breaths later those Eastern Sea rank eights attack together; he recasts and they fall into the ocean again. He holds the tempo of the fight.

When Longevity Heaven invades, Duke Long activates it again as a qi path killer move: myriad qi rampages and the world changes colors. Gu Immortals at rank eight shake under the same all-around pressure, many killer moves collapse, and the Northern Plains experts pursuing him fall into the water. Calamity Luck Altar can barely operate; its thin light halo resists the move, and the luck path rank eight Immortal Gu House cannot fly, forced to stay on the ground. Bing Sai Chuan recognizes the Eastern Sea cast and says the current power is more than ten times what it was then.

Inside Heavenly Court, Duke Long uses it to destroy Fang Yuan’s myriad self after the transportation formation falls. An unparalleled force descends and presses the whole place; the world becomes still. Fang Yuan’s clones are all destroyed, Calamity Luck Altar is forced to the ground, and Heavenly Court Immortal Gu Houses in range are directly destroyed. Fang Yuan and Myriad Year Flying Warship are enveloped as well: the warship’s speed falls and it descends while bearing the weight of mountains and rivers. Fang Yuan knows the move from the previous life’s Dragon Palace fight, where Duke Long used it to claim victory. After immemorial year monkey transformation turns his dao marks into time path dao marks, he drives the time path Immortal Gu House at full force and it shoots out as if the pressure were not there.
Later in the same invasion, when Duke Long emerges from dragon gate behind Fang Yuan’s immemorial sword dragon, he uses this move to delay Fang Yuan’s speed before chaotic dragon fist lands.
